name: serpapi_walmart_search
description: Search Walmart products with pictures, prices/currency, ratings, review counts, seller, product_id and numeric us_item_id. Use for 'find coffee makers at Walmart', 'show Walmart groceries', 'Walmart vacuums under $100' or price-sorted comparisons. Local prices use store_id or configured Walmart store/ZIP when resolvable; check location_context and the returned location before claiming nearby stock. Returns product cards in Jarvis Web. For details or reviews of an already selected product use serpapi_walmart_product with its saved product_id and store_id instead of repeating the search. One cached SerpApi search request; no purchases. Returned filter catalogs carry exact provider facet IDs for follow-ups; reuse those values, never invent IDs from brand labels. If no matching filter option is returned, refine keywords instead and describe that as a keyword search.

query.description: Walmart product keywords, e.g. coffee maker, cordless vacuum, groceries. Required unless cat_id supplied.

cat_id.description: US category ID from prior filters, optionally instead of query.

num_results.description: Number of product cards to return; default 5, clamped 1..10.

sort_by.description: Requested sort; price/rating sorting disables relevance blending unless soft_sort explicitly true.

page.description: Results page; default 1. Use for additional products.

facet.description: Exact facet value from a returned filters option with param=facet; combine exact tokens with ||. Do not invent IDs from human-readable brand/attribute labels. Category options use cat_id, not facet. If no matching catalog option is returned, refine query keywords instead.

soft_sort.description: US relevance blending. False by default when sort_by supplied to honor price/rating order.

next_day.description: US NextDay delivery products only; default false.

spelling.description: Allow Walmart spelling fixes; provider default true.

walmart_domain.description: Storefront; default US walmart.com. Mexico requires explicit store_id for local results and supports fewer filters. Product detail tool supports US only.

store_id.description: Explicit Walmart store ID for local prices/availability; overrides all location defaults.

postal_code.description: Optional US ZIP override; otherwise uses configured Walmart store or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE. Exact ZIP-to-store lookup only; unmatched ZIP is explicitly reported, never treated as local availability.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi cache. Default false; exact cached responses are free.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
